content: Blueprinting KeywordSet KeywordSet can be blueprinted. The following derivation rules apply: • No keywords may be removed from or added to the KeywordSet • The shortName of Keyword shall not be changed or extended • [TPS_STDT_00085] applies except that longName of Keyword shall not be changed, but it is allowed to add representations in further languages. • The abbrName shall not be changed or extended(AbbrName) • The classification of a Keyword shall not be changed but it is allowed to provide additional classification .
